text_block_list.text:
I inform Narita Brian of some sudden
changes to
her training regimen.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Who do you take me for?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
If there's good reason for making a
change, I'll
accept it. That's only natural.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...You haven't said anything that doesn't
make
sense to me before.
choice_data_list: まだその意味を説明してないけど……

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Your actions always lead to the desired
outcome.
I assumed that would be the
case this time as well.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Don't make me start regretting it now,
all right?

Narita Brian seems to be satisfied with
the results
of her training.
